title: Installation of Drinking Water Fountains in Areas of High Footfall
what_it_is: Installation of Drinking Water Fountains in Areas of High Footfall

sections.label: Water dispensers at public premises
sections.summary: MOH and other agencies increased water dispensers, now at all hawker centres, parks, bus interchanges and terminals, and owners are encouraged to install them.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Health (MOH) has worked with the National Environment Agency (NEA), Housing and Development Board (HDB), Land Transport Authority (LTA) and National Parks Board (NParks) to increase the availability of water dispensers.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: They are now installed at all hawker centres, and are also available at parks, bus interchanges and terminals.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Owners of other premises are also encouraged to install water dispensers and water coolers.

sections.label: Mandatory water dispenser installation concerns
sections.summary: Mandatory installation entails regulation, enforcement and resources, and drinking water is largely available from taps, though hydration and healthy lifestyle nudges matter.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera
sentences.text: Is there any impediment that is holding it back?

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: However, in relation to the mandatory installation which is being proposed, mandatory installation entails regulation, enforcement and other resources that has to be put in place.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: At this juncture, drinking water is potable and it is something that is available largely from taps and that might not be the direction that we are heading to at this juncture.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: Having said that I do see the importance of actually encouraging hydration, but our healthy lifestyle strategies are quite multi-faceted, and we are looking at various dimensions to increase awareness and also implementation of nudges for healthy lifestyle behaviours to the public.
